name: The Stride
title: A viaduct spine across the city, streets beneath it
axes: x east, z north, y up; metres; the camp at the origin on y 0

tiers.7: the upper town and the deck

description: One structure organises the whole map: the Stride, a 600 m railway viaduct on brick arches, 7 m up, running edge to edge just north of the camp. The deck is a long open fighting line with a stalled train for cover, and the streets pass under it through the arches. North, you go straight under Arch Nought and up Crag Road and Crag Street to City Hall on the Crag. East, you climb a short stair onto the deck itself and run it to the Terminus, a raised door where the line lands on the upper town. South, a steep haul ramp drops you into the Vale and a cutting takes you down again to a sunk door in the Goods Cut. West, the yard runs out flat to the Valley Steps, then a sunken lane turns north under the viaduct into Arch Valley, where the piers stand 14 m tall, to the Arches Market hall, a door on the lowest street. The horde moves under the deck while you fight on it; the Signal Bridge and four stairs tie the deck, the valley and the upper town together.

hub.name: Arch Yard: a yard tucked under the viaduct, the Vale dropping away south
